Report the specific numeric LUMO value and distinguish calculated value from database-recorded value.'}

The SELFIES decodes to **OC1C2C3CC1CCN23** (canonical SMILES: **OC1C2CCN3C(C2)C13**; formula **C₇H₁₁NO**).

The LUMO energy is **0.0694 Ha**, reported as a calculated quantum-chemical value from a **QM9 InChIKey match**. No separate database-recorded LUMO value was found; the profile lookup also found no valid PubChem record.
